**Build log: UI Tweaks VI** (built by Claude Fable 5.1 through Claude Code; not committed)

**What was built, and where**

- **Reply and Contest** (`index.html`, `consensus.css`): on a resolved or applied thread the Reply button reads "Reply and Contest" in the contested colour, its title saying the thread reopens and stays contested; on a contested thread it stays "Reply". Nothing else changed.
- **Save stays in Edit** (`edit.js`): the Save button and Ctrl+S save and keep the editor open on the new revision (the base moves on before the reload, so the reload does not read as stale); the toast says "Saved, revision N". The editor's line now reads "Editing revision N. Ctrl+S saves; Ctrl+E saves and reads."
- **Menu bar** (`index.html`, `help.js`, `consensus.css`): the Project and Import buttons are gone; the bar beside the brand has one menu, Help, opened in the page's popup menu with About and Hotkeys. New Project, Import and Settings stay in the server row's menu, as they were (the row's Settings button too). **About**: the version (the desktop's own, else the server's from /api/me), the Source and Online guide links (a new tab; the desktop hands them to the system browser), and one block per server with a table per project: threads, contested, waiting on me, waiting on LLMs, summed from the tallies the tree holds when the popup opens (plans and Subplans, folders walked; documents and the Archive left out; "waiting on LLMs" over every participant whose Role is llm). **Hotkeys**: the table below.
- **Hotkeys** (`hotkeys.js`, new): one table of rows { Keys, Label, When, Act } drives the Help page and one window keydown listener (capture, so it is heard before the editor). Ctrl+E moved out of `header.js` and Ctrl+C/V out of `sidebar.js`; Ctrl+S stays Monaco's binding and the listener takes it too in Edit (so it saves with the focus on the preview, and the browser's own save never opens). Controllers hand in Save, EditToRead, Copy and Paste with `Hotkeys.Provide`. The rows: Ctrl+E (Edit; from Edit, save and read), Ctrl+S, Ctrl+C, Ctrl+V, Escape (deselects the thread when no menu or popup is open), Ctrl+Shift+E (tree), Ctrl+Shift+T or Ctrl+Shift+H (threads), Ctrl+Shift+C (comment on the whole document), Ctrl+PgUp or Alt+PgUp, Ctrl+PgDn or Alt+PgDn, Ctrl+Home or Alt+Home, Ctrl+End or Alt+End (the tabs, wrapping, ghosted tabs skipped). The rules as planned: no hotkey but Escape while a popup is open; Ctrl+C and Ctrl+V are the browser's own while typing or with text selected; the tab keys yield to the editor and do nothing in a detached window; Cmd for Ctrl on a Mac in the Hotkeys page. An act runs inside a digest, as a click's would.
- **Ctrl+E from Edit** (`edit.js`): a dirty, unrefused edit is saved, then Read; a refused save stays in Edit with the error; nothing to save (or a stale edit, kept as a draft as the Read button keeps it) just goes to Read.
- **Toast** (`toast.js`, new; `index.html`, `consensus.css`): one line at the bottom of the main pane, shown two seconds, a later message replacing the earlier; used by Save, and by Copy and Paste (the sidebar's notice line stays, and now toasts too).
- **Detached window** (`index.html`, `app.js`): the bar beside Re-attach has Hide threads / Show threads (Ctrl+Shift+T there too); a detached window starts from the shared remembered value and never writes it.
- **Deselect** (`read.js`): a click in the read section off any highlight, with no text selection, not on the selection's buttons and not while re-anchoring, deselects; the card's reply form folds, the draft kept. Escape too (hotkeys.js).
- **The selection moves on** (`threads.js`): after your own Reply, Reply and Contest, Reply and resolve or Resolve, the selection goes to the next listed thread after it in the pane's order, else the previous, else none; the card scrolls into view with its form open. Comment and Comment and resolve still select the thread they post.
- **Project tree** (`index.html`, `consensus.css`): under a server's row everything starts one indent further in (`.root-body { --row-start }`: the projects and their trees). Two new icons: a server (two rack units with a light each) beside the live dot, and a project (a folder with a tab, outlined when closed, filled when open, in its own green) in place of the dot. Two new sprite symbols (info, keyboard) for the Help menu.
- **Docs**: `editing.md` (save and Ctrl+E, the detached bar's button, a Hotkeys section with the table), `threads.md` (Reply and Contest, deselect, the selection moving on), `projects.md` (the icons, Help, New Project in the server's menu), the README; the guide rebuilt with `node bin/docs.js build`, not published.

**How it was tested**

- `test/Ui.test.js` (a real headless Chrome over CDP, the server on a temporary folder): the existing tests updated where the page changed (New Project and Import picked from the server row's menu; the project and server icons; Ctrl+E now saving; Save staying in Edit with the toast and "Editing revision 2"; the resolve test now also checks the selection moving to none, Reply and Contest on the resolved thread, and the blank-click and Escape deselect; the reply-and-resolve test re-picks the thread after the reply moves on; the detached-window test clicks the threads button and checks the shared key is untouched). Two new tests: the hotkeys (Ctrl+Shift+T, H, E, C and the Alt tab keys with two tabs) and Help (About's version, links and summary rows; the Hotkeys table's twelve rows; Escape closing each).
- The whole suite: `node --test`, 178 pass, 0 fail.
- Screenshots over a temporary server, light and dark, checked by eye: the tree, the Help menu, About, Hotkeys, Reply and Contest, the toast after a save, a detached window with its threads hidden.

**Decided during the build**

- Ctrl+S with the focus outside the editor but in Edit saves too.
- In the test harness Ctrl+Shift+C is taken by the renderer's inspect-element handling while a debugger is attached (a real browser does the same only with DevTools open), so that test dispatches the key event on the page itself.

- The Help menu is not in a detached window, which has no sidebar, as the plan left it.
- The server row keeps its Settings button and its live dot beside the new icon.

The context node in the consensus project does not expand. it seems to expand in other projects.

**Fixed: the Consensus project's Context folder unfolds again.**

The cause was the folds, not the folder. The folds are remembered per server (`consensus.<server>.folded`, a list of folder ids), and the page took a node as folded when *any* server's list had its id (sidebar.js, since Run Shapes, Step 5: "an id belongs to one root"). The Consensus project came into the checkout from cube4 with its ids, and cube4's remembered list still names its Context folder (fld-vi6-61j-kzx) as folded; a click toggled the local server's list, which cube4's list overrode every time, so the folder never opened. The other projects' folders are only on one server, so they were fine.

Now a node is folded when its own project's server remembers it so, and that list alone (`IsFolded( node, project )`, `ToggleFold( node, project, event )`, the template handing in the project); the other servers' lists are not looked at. The stale entry in cube4's list is harmless and left alone.

A browser test reproduces it: a second, offline root whose remembered list holds the Context folder, which still folds and unfolds; the test fails with the old check and passes now. Whole suite: `node --test`, 179 pass, 0 fail.
